extracted.intended_audience: Reuters journalists, editors and media professionals (including PR writers seeking Reuters-style guidance)
extracted.subtask_description: Canonical Reuters newsroom/stylebook guidance covering accuracy, structure, legal and ethical standards for news stories and press materials; this page chunk is an index listing handbook topics rather than full prose guidance. Use the listed topics to find the detailed rules in the full Reuters Handbook.
